modules.title: Introduction to Data Structures
modules.description: This module aims to introduce students to the importance and significance of data structures. Students will learn about the basic concepts, types, and applications of various data structures.

sub_modules.title: Data Structures Fundamentals
sub_modules.description: This sub-module focuses on the basic concepts and operations of arrays and linked lists. Students will understand how to implement, manipulate, and optimize these data structures.

activities.title: Learn Array Operations
activities.description: Practice understanding array operations including indexing, slicing, concatenation, and sorting.

activities.title: Understand Linked Lists Basics
activities.description: Understand the concept of a linked list, its types, and basic operations such as insertion, deletion, and traversal.

sub_modules.title: Data Structures Applications
sub_modules.description: In this sub-module, students will learn about real-world applications of various data structures such as stacks, queues, trees, and graphs.

activities.title: Understand Stacks and Queues
activities.description: Learn the concepts and operations of stacks and queues. Understand their use cases in programming.

activities.title: Study Tree Data Structures
activities.description: Learn the concept of tree data structures including binary trees, AVL trees, and BSTs. Understand their use cases in programming.

sub_modules.title: Practice Problem-Solving
sub_modules.description: In this module, students will engage in various problems to develop their problem-solving skills. Students will apply the concepts learned from previous modules.

activities.title: Practice Data Structures Problems
activities.description: Solve practice problems related to data structures and algorithms using online platforms or coding challenges.

activities.title: Participate in Online Challenges
activities.description: Engage with online coding challenges and participate in problem-solving sessions to develop problem-solving skills.

quiz_adaptations: Practice array operations, linked list basics
